programme.desc: (1988) Action comedy. Robert De Niro stars as a bounty hunter transporting a criminal from New York to Los Angeles with the FBI and the mob hot on their tail. With Charles Grodin.

programme.title: Warlock
programme.desc: (1989) Fantasy horror with Julian Sands and Richard E Grant. Using magic, an evil warlock flees to 80s LA from the olde-worlde. Can he unmake creation before a witch-finder tracks him down?

programme.title: Submarine

programme.title: It Came from Outer Space

programme.title: Brian and Charles

programme.title: The Martian Interview Special
programme.desc: Director Ridley Scott talks about making his science-fiction survival adventure starring Matt Damon.

programme.title: The Martian
programme.desc: (2015) Matt Damon stars in Ridley Scott's drama about an astronaut who accidentally gets left behind on Mars. Oops. How will he survive and how on earth can he get home?

programme.title: Kingsman: The Golden Circle
programme.desc: (2017) Taron Egerton returns as the newest recruit to the stylish secret agency Kingsman for more ass-kicking comedy action. A star-studded cast includes Julianne Moore and Elton John.

programme.title: Chopper

programme.title: The Hunt
programme.desc: (2020) Fighty, satirical horror that upset Donald Trump. Hilary Swank plays a rich lefty who likes hunting working class people to the death. But she didn't reckon on Betty Gilpin.

programme.title: The Art of Racing in the Rain

programme.title: Sink the Bismarck!
